candidate_id_policy.allocation_order: First canonical source-unit occurrence, then canonical image-reference order, with IDs allocated only by the root merge step.
candidate_id_policy.worker_policy: Isolated workers use stage-local W identifiers and never allocate B identifiers.
candidate_id_policy.reuse_policy: Never reuse or renumber an allocated B identifier.
candidate_id_policy.split_policy: The child containing the earliest canonical identity/mechanics evidence keeps the original ID; later children receive the next IDs; the superseded parent relationship remains recorded.
candidate_id_policy.merge_policy: Only explicit alias/duplicate identity evidence permits a blind-phase merge. The earliest ID remains active and every merged ID remains as a redirect record.

eligibility_criteria.capture_when: Canonical Book evidence states or unambiguously diagrams a transition, generation, replacement, evaluation, relation, constraint, probability, input-processing, or completion law over a defined object.
eligibility_criteria.do_not_capture_when: The unit states only an observed outcome, behavioral property, rendering convention, application, analogy, or historical fact and supplies no native law or independently named coverage obligation.

eligibility_criteria.capture_when: Canonical Book evidence names or formally delimits a system and supplies at least one identity-bearing mechanic, even though other mechanics remain missing or cross-referenced.
eligibility_criteria.do_not_capture_when: Only a name or Index entry occurs and no in-context Book passage supplies identity-bearing mechanics; record a route or identity-only evidence instead.

eligibility_criteria.capture_when: Canonical Book evidence gives a named or materially delimited preset, restriction, seed/input/boundary class, schedule, composition, or variant whose separate traceability could be lost if folded into another mention.
eligibility_criteria.do_not_capture_when: The difference is merely a display choice, empirical observation, informal adjective, or duplicated wording with no coverage-bearing identity.

eligibility_criteria.capture_when: Canonical Book evidence defines a relation, constraint/model set, immutable function, constant, equation, axiom system, or query with a determinate denotation or accepted-result condition, whether or not it has native time evolution.
eligibility_criteria.do_not_capture_when: The unit merely uses ordinary mathematics to describe another construction and does not define an independently queryable or coverage-bearing object.

eligibility_criteria.capture_when: After reading the complete unit and context, there is a concrete, source-grounded possibility that native mechanics or a coverage-bearing identity is present but a defect, missing target, or underdetermination prevents resolution.
eligibility_criteria.do_not_capture_when: Uncertainty comes only from not yet reading the available context or from external textbook expectations.

reading_disposition_rules.CANDIDATE: Use iff the unit satisfies at least one eligibility criterion and introduces or materially changes identity-bearing mechanics or a coverage-bearing obligation.
reading_disposition_rules.SUPPORTS_CANDIDATE: Use iff the unit contributes mechanics, parameters, restrictions, examples, or evidence to a B candidate but does not independently introduce its identity.
reading_disposition_rules.CROSS_REFERENCE: Use iff the unit's construction-relevant content is principally a route whose target must be read before mechanics can be established.
reading_disposition_rules.REPRESENTATION_OR_OBSERVER: Use iff the unit principally encodes, renders, measures, analyzes, transforms, or summarizes another object without supplying a new native law.
reading_disposition_rules.APPLICATION_OR_EMULATION: Use iff the unit principally applies, interprets, or emulates an identified construction without specifying a new native or coupling law.
reading_disposition_rules.HISTORICAL_ONLY: Use iff the unit concerns provenance, attribution, chronology, or terminology and supplies no mechanics or live route.
reading_disposition_rules.NO_CONSTRUCTION: Use iff complete in-context reading establishes that none of the other seven dispositions applies.
reading_disposition_rules.SOURCE_DEFECT_OR_AMBIGUITY: Use iff a source defect or genuine Book ambiguity blocks a sound primary disposition; record attempted resolution and any linked candidate or route.

disposition_precedence: SOURCE_DEFECT_OR_AMBIGUITY when the defect prevents a sound ordinary disposition
CANDIDATE when an eligibility criterion is met
SUPPORTS_CANDIDATE when mechanics support an existing candidate
CROSS_REFERENCE when routing is the unit's principal construction role

evidence_strengths.DIRECT_COMPLETE: Canonical prose, formula, code, table, or independently checked explicit diagram supplies enough mechanics to instantiate the claimed object/event/denotation.
evidence_strengths.DIRECT_PARTIAL: Canonical evidence supplies identity-bearing mechanics but one or more fingerprint fields remain genuinely unspecified or unresolved.
evidence_strengths.DIRECT_IDENTITY_ONLY: Canonical evidence establishes a name or delimited identity but not enough mechanics to instantiate it; this cannot alone justify a mechanics claim.
evidence_strengths.CORROBORATING: Canonical evidence supports a mechanic, parameter, alias, restriction, property, or provenance already established elsewhere but cannot establish identity alone.
evidence_strengths.VISUAL_EXPLICIT: An original-resolution image visibly and unambiguously establishes the recorded fact and the transcription/interpretation is independently checked against caption or context.
evidence_strengths.VISUAL_CONTEXT_ONLY: An image supports relationship or appearance only; it cannot establish hidden rule data, timing, colors, or coordinates.
evidence_strengths.DEFECT_LIMITED: Available canonical evidence is damaged, contradictory, missing its target, or otherwise unable to decide the recorded mechanic; the exact boundary is stated.

unknown_value_policy: Every fingerprint key is present. Use UNKNOWN_FROM_SOURCE only after available in-scope context and routes have been exhausted, and duplicate the exact unresolved fact in missing_mechanics.

same_family: Complete source-grounded fingerprints exist for both sides.

Either a total structural/relational map with an inverse on its valid image commutes for one native event/result, or both are proved instances/restrictions of one explicit parameterized schema with unchanged mechanics.

The proof preserves program data, complete state/denotation, invariants, target selection, schedule, read snapshot, effects or relation, successor cardinality/probability, completion/failure, witnesses, and native event granularity.
No hidden interpreter, phase clock, callback, opaque packing, lossy projection, or multi-step emulation supplies the correspondence.
specialization_preset_property_seed: State the exact parameter restriction, predicate, constructor, property, or input law.
Prove native mechanics are otherwise unchanged.
State separately whether the Book identity still warrants catalog coverage.
composition_hybrid: State the coupling law, data flow, event ordering, and shared state.
Prove whether the coupling is ordinary composition or introduces an irreducible coupling algebra.
Do not hide one component in another component's opaque value.
representation_observer_application_emul: State the exact source role and represented, observed, applied, or emulated construction.
Show that no new native law is specified, or capture that law as a separate candidate.
Keep encoding, rendering, measurement, solving, and decoding outside native events.
new_catalog_entry: Provide sufficient canonical Book identity and an evidence packet.
Assign one final semantic role and family action.
Show what traceable Book obligation would be lost by folding it into another catalog row.
Do not require family novelty merely because catalog coverage is new.
new_semantic_family: Provide sufficient canonical Book mechanics to instantiate the construction.
Give a concrete native event, result, or denotation whose state, schedule, reads, probability, structure, successor cardinality, completion, or witnesses cannot be preserved by that family.
Show the difference is not a parameter, restriction, seed, representation, generic composition, observer, or another instance of one explicit parameterized schema.
source_insufficient: Exhaust all canonical context, local searches, and queued routes.
State exactly which identity or mechanic remains missing, damaged, or contradictory.
Separate facts established by the Book from external expectations.
Use the explicit source-insufficient final values rather than inventing semantics.

worker_isolation.context_mode: Spawn discovery workers without inherited conversation context.
allowed_inputs: the assigned canonical Markdown document or deterministic source-unit slice
only images owned by that assigned slice
blind ledger schemas and write-free validation instructions
forbidden_inputs: other workers' candidate mappings before root merge
whole-corpus trigger searches before assigned sequential reading
output_contract: Return source-unit dispositions, candidate proposals, image reviews, routes, and uncertainties only for the assigned range.
Include every required fingerprint key and never include a forbidden blind field.
Do not edit shared ledgers; the root merge allocates B IDs in canonical order and records provenance.

blind_freeze_requirements: All assigned canonical source units have exactly one primary reading disposition.
All physical images have a visual-screening record and all image references have an asset row.
Every local and saturation search hit has a final blind disposition.
Every relevant cross-reference is resolved or has an explicit defect boundary.
Every active candidate has every fingerprint key, complete provenance, and explicit missing mechanics.
Blind artifacts contain none of the forbidden blind fields.
Artifact hashes are frozen before any Stage 19 input is opened.
